systems.country_label: future SIPAO data collection and registration centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: INTERPOL programme funded by the European Union (11th European Development Fund); Gambia's Ministry of the Interior received the equipment
systems.tiers: Not yet in use: The Gambia joined in November 2017 and signed the memorandum of understanding; workstations, scanners and servers were handed over on 3 July 2019 to begin digitising police data held on paper; premises for the centre found and under rehabilitation, inauguration possible at the end of 2019; first training in August 2019

note: For The Gambia the newsletter reports the equipment handover, the premises and the first training, ahead of any use; it does not say that stations enter reports or cases in the system, so no fact of class record. This is the French edition of the document at n 33.
